name: gitlab-clickhouse
description: Inspect GitLab local ClickHouse tables, schemas, ingestion paths, and data patterns. Use for CH table questions, DESCRIBE TABLE, schema and source-of-truth checks under db/click_house, ingestion debugging, and investigating aggregates, distributions, outliers, or anomalous ClickHouse data in a GitLab GDK environment.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect GitLab local ClickHouse tables, schemas, ingestion paths, and data patterns. Use for CH table questions, DESCRIBE TABLE, schema and source-of-truth checks under db/click_house, ingestion debugging, and investigating aggregates, distributions, outliers, or anomalous ClickHouse data in a GitLab GDK environment.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the local ClickHouse database in a GitLab GDK environment to inspect schemas, run DESCRIBE TABLE queries, trace ingestion paths under db/click_house, and investigate aggregates, distributions, outliers, or anomalous data patterns. Use this skill when you need to answer questions about ClickHouse table structure, verify source-of-truth definitions, debug ingestion pipelines, or explore analytics data without leaving your development environment.
